steps.id: Beli formulir pendaftaran dari bagian admission (transfer/debit).
steps.en: Buy the registration form from Admissions (transfer/debit).
A voucher code is sent by email.

steps.id: Daftar dan verifikasi email di binus.edu/admissions, lalu lengkapi data registrasi.
steps.en: Sign up and verify your email at binus.edu/admissions, then complete the registration details.

steps.id: Pilih jadwal tes masuk dan isi booking form dengan kode voucher.
steps.en: Choose an entrance test date and fill in the booking form with the voucher code.

steps.id: Unggah semua dokumen yang diminta dan tunggu verifikasi.
steps.en: Upload all required documents and wait for verification.

steps.id: Unduh kartu tes dan dokumen pendukung.
steps.en: Download the test card and supporting documents.

steps.id: Ikuti tes masuk dan serahkan dokumen pendukung yang sudah diisi ke bagian admission.
steps.en: Attend the entrance test and hand in the completed supporting documents.

notes.id: Halaman tidak menyebut tahun ajaran; prosedur yang berlaku per November 2026. Kurikulum IB (PYP, MYP, DP) dan nasional. Kontak admission: +62 21 7243663.
notes.en: The page does not state the academic year; procedure as of November 2026. IB (PYP, MYP, DP) and national curriculum. Admissions: +62 21 7243663.
